title: RentGuard Fee Tariff — Late Fee, Returned Payments and Courtesy Waivers
content:
This tariff lists, for every tier of the RentGuard Renters Policy, the late fee on a late installment and its grace period, the fee on a payment returned unpaid, the number of returned payments in 12 months that suspends EFT for the rest of the term, and the number of courtesy waivers of a late or returned-payment fee allowed per rolling 12 months.

| Tier | Late fee per late installment (USD) | Late-fee grace period (calendar days past the due date) | Returned-payment fee (USD) | Returned payments in 12 months that suspend EFT | Courtesy fee waivers per rolling 12 months |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| RentGuard HO-4 Starter | 5.00 | 10 | 20.00 | 2 | 1 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Essential | 5.00 | 10 | 20.00 | 2 | 1 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Enhanced | 5.00 | 10 | 20.00 | 2 | 1 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Premier | 5.00 | 10 | 20.00 | 2 | 1 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Premier Plus | 0.00 | 10 | 15.00 | 3 | 2 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Signature | 0.00 | 10 | 0.00 | 3 | 2 |

## Tariff notes

- A figure of 0.00 means the fee does not exist on that tier: HO-4 Premier Plus and HO-4 Signature carry no late fee, and HO-4 Signature carries no returned-payment fee.
- The grace period is the same 10 calendar days on every tier.
- The EFT-suspension count is reached on the second returned payment within 12 months on the four lower tiers and on the third on HO-4 Premier Plus and HO-4 Signature.
- The courtesy allowance is 1 waiver per rolling 12 months on the four lower tiers and 2 on HO-4 Premier Plus and HO-4 Signature.
